_about: James Hayden Tufts (1862-1942), Chicago pragmatist and social ethicist. Raw IA OCR: Our Democracy, its origins and its tasks (Henry Holt, 1917); The Ethics of Cooperation, a lecture (Houghton Mifflin, 1918; copyright the Regents of the University of California). His Ethics with Dewey (1908) is on the john-dewey shelf; his translation of Windelband is translator work and is not taken here. US public domain. No uids minted.
